descriptors.title: Product and menu orders
descriptors.invariant: No stock-confirmed-order-to-paid inference; no direct cash in NEXG payout.

descriptors.title: On-site services
descriptors.billingBasis: accepted service and separately classified booking payment
descriptors.invariant: Advance is credited once; completion does not prove payment.

descriptors.title: Remote services
descriptors.billingBasis: provider service charge and actual remaining balance
descriptors.invariant: No venue, travel or vehicle lines without an actual contract.

descriptors.title: Rentals and security
descriptors.billingBasis: rental unit/contract period, extensions, independent security
descriptors.invariant: Physical return does not release money; refundable security is not rental sales.

descriptors.title: Trips and greeters
descriptors.billingBasis: one root trip/greeting price and actual inclusions
descriptors.invariant: Driver and vehicle do not create another sale; greeter-only has no car income.

descriptors.title: Event tickets
descriptors.invariant: Ticket/participant count is not payment count; cancelled event is not a refund.

descriptors.title: Group sessions
descriptors.invariant: Included membership places are not resold; joint resources do not duplicate bills.

descriptors.title: Tables and spaces
descriptors.billingBasis: reservation charge/credited advance, minimum spend and final bill
descriptors.invariant: Minimum spend is a commitment until the owner charges it; credit advance once.

descriptors.title: Tours and itineraries
descriptors.billingBasis: shared departure or private accepted itinerary; principal/agent basis
descriptors.invariant: Supplier/customer pass-through is not automatically merchant revenue.

descriptors.title: Quoted work
descriptors.billingBasis: accepted scope, milestones, invoices and collections
descriptors.invariant: Requested/accepted quote is not cash, invoice debt or recognized revenue.

descriptors.title: Custom production
descriptors.billingBasis: accepted specification, approved change and progress/final bill
descriptors.invariant: Unaccepted change and production deadline do not create payment.

descriptors.title: Measured linked services
descriptors.billingBasis: accepted rate and confirmed measured quantity on one commercial root
descriptors.invariant: Collection/processing/return legs do not each create revenue.

descriptors.title: Workshop and service jobs
descriptors.billingBasis: approved assessment, parts/labour and staged/final invoice
descriptors.invariant: Queue estimate is not invoice debt; approved changes already included are not added again.

descriptors.title: Memberships and retainers
descriptors.billingBasis: contracted billing period, credits and renewal
descriptors.invariant: Cash collection is not automatically earned revenue; included redemption is not a sale.

descriptors.title: Freight
descriptors.billingBasis: agreed chargeable measure and authorized separate service lines
descriptors.invariant: No guessed dimensional conversion; carrier/customs funds classified by contract.

descriptors.title: Storage
descriptors.billingBasis: declared space unit and billing period
descriptors.invariant: No assumed proration; custody end and money settlement remain independent.

descriptors.title: Regulated enquiry/referral
descriptors.invariant: No customer banking, loan, FX, remittance or wallet balances or executable rails.
